rationale: Recent runs are flat and recurrence scheduling is still underexplored locally. This keeps the winning reverse recurrent-tail, decoder-anchor carry, skips, and quant-aware export path intact, but during training it downweights earlier recurrent blocks early, ramps them smoothly to full strength over the train budget, and forces full recurrence for the quant-aware/final endgame so the exact scored architecture is unchanged at evaluation.
title: Tail-Recur Depth Curriculum Before Quant-Aware Endgame
